references.text: The Lord declares Himself to be a jealous God who does not tolerate idolatry, the same theme as in Deuteronomy 6:15
The Lord's name is 'Jealous', and He is a jealous God who demands faithfulness
Describes the Lord as a consuming fire and a jealous God
Warns of the Lord's wrath and jealousy, which will destroy those who turn to other gods
Joshua warns the people that the Lord is a jealous God who will not forgive apostasy
The prophet Nahum describes the Lord as a jealous and avenging God
Warns of a terrible judgment and burning jealousy that will consume the enemies
Refers to our God being a consuming fire, reflecting Deuteronomy 6:15
